notes.title: Eldervale Patch Notes (1.2.2)
notes.content:
[h3]Eldervale Patch Notes (1.2.2)[/h3]

- After finishing Chapter 1, some parts of the level will be blocked off to avoid pointless backtracking. 
- The Elder Costume will now adapt to the base costume variation, changing it's color and texture.
- Equip Melee weapon now bound to the "4" key in addition to "0".
- Resources now spawn for twice as long during the bossfight.
- Default camera type is now "Medium" instead of "Far".
- SMG bullet spread reduced.
- If you fail to pick up the 2F or B1 maps, they will appear on a different place later in the game.
- Added camera events to the Statue, Patient and Dial puzzles when solved.
- Added a camera event near the SMG.
- You can no longer leave the basement before picking up the Handgun.

Originally, the entire level was accessible by the end of the game to provide shortcuts to previously visited save points or vending machines and get more "a-ha!" moments when returning to old areas. 
But this reward proved small, compared to the frustrating effect it had on some players who ended up backtracking to old areas that were irrelevant to progressing.

[h3]
Deep Reserves DLC[/h3]

- Objectives are now listed in inventory during gameplay.
- Start with more handgun ammo.
- Additional enemy reset points added.
- Mimic damage reduced by half.
- Stalkers can now be killed with candles.

notes.title: Eldervale Free DLC Update 1.2.0 - Deep Reserves
notes.content:
[h1]Eldervale 1.2.0 - Deep Reserves[/h1]

[b]Hello everyone! Hope you're doing good![/b]

Deep Reserves is a challenge map featuring branching paths, new enemies, plenty of secrets and it's own progression system. It takes place after the main game's events and you start with all weapons and equipment. It's recommended to tackle this content after completing the main game at least once. 

There are no save points in Deep Reserves, you have to reach an escape point or the very end to survive. 
[h3]
Progression[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991365/665172b74b9d86f4e74c9e9128a2e2c1299b2df3.png[/img]

You have multiple ways of earning Elder Runes, a currency that can be spent after each run to increase your power permanently. The win conditions are tailored towards combat-oriented and speedrunner playstyles. You will have to kill as many enemies as you can or get to an escape point quickly to earn runes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991365/00a8c121540666a8ecdc85839b0341fb98259db9.png[/img]

There are also plenty of secrets, big and small. Finding more and more of these will make your attempts more manageable by providing you with ammo and healing items.    

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991365/0ec0fb7b375d806c050ce20a991131415f473abf.png[/img]

You will come across areas where you need to solve randomized puzzles. Finding the most optimal path around these sections can save you time to meet the requirements for a rune.

[h3]Win Conditions[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991365/3774230223595e7f273644db7745a373be8b0941.png[/img]

These are subject to change as players will share their feedback. Here are a few current examples:

[b]To gain 1 rune.[/b]

- Get 30 kills and escape through the Laboratory (around the 2/3 mark).

- Get to the escape point in under 10 minutes.

[b]To gain 2 runes.[/b]

- Get 50 kills and escape through the Laboratory.

- Get to the escape point in under 5 minutes.

[b]To gain 3 runes.[/b]

- Get 50 kills, reach the final area and kill the boss in under 15 minutes.


[h3]Rewards[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991365/c597bab24945e7eb72ab7db7945791a4bda34ae8.png[/img]

The main unlockable tied to Deep Reserves is the Elder costume. Once unlocked, it can be used in both the DLC and the main game. It's unique among the other costumes, as it can be equipped together with other skins. It is also animated and doubles as a light source.

You can unlock this costume by doing a single perfect run by killing the boss and many enemies under a tight time limit OR level up your profile to maximum.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991365/7f8eb6a23f3a47b64118185c5f960fab61e2b5ca.png[/img]

[h3]More Information[/h3]

There are still many features and details I didn't cover like how the DLC fits into the story, new enemies, tips on how to rake up those Elder Runes and what's next to the DLC and the game in general. 

Many exciting things to share, keep an eye on the game's Steam page for updates, or join our Discord Community to ask me anything and provide quick feedback: 

https://discord.gg/VryNBv5

Deep Reserves is beta is now available! The other half of the DLC will arrive soon, during the season.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991365/b94c963ed8503adab679e7b8cc77e76ff7b55ab1.png[/img]

[h3]Changelog for the upcoming patch:[/h3]

- Deep Reserves beta is available to play.

- Field of View slider added.
- Camera Types option added.
- Default physics hair improved.

- Added sound effects when switching equipment.
- New sound effect for melee hits.
- New sound effects added for items.

- Torso enemies no longer have a hitbox when killed.

- Added new costume (Elder). Unlock it by reaching max level in Deep Reserves or doing a perfect run.
- Tokens needed to unlock the Goldie costume have been reduced from 100 to 75.

notes.title: Upcoming Free Content: Eldervale Deep Reserves (1.1.0)
notes.content:
Upcoming Free Content: Eldervale Deep Reserves (1.1.0)

Hey, everyone!

Now that the game's launch has passed and we got some fixes in place, it's time to talk about the game's future.

First of all, as a solo developer without any backing or marketing, I feel lucky and honored to have anyone give the game a chance and buy it to support it's further development. You are awesome and I couldn't continue working on games without you!

Written appreciations are cool and all, but I felt those who purchased the game deserved more than that, so there is substantial free content coming soon, titled Deep Reserves!   

Deep Reserves is a new standalone mode and map coming to Eldervale soon. Like in the main game, you can choose between 3 difficulty options, though there won't be separate options for Combat and Puzzle for this mode. 

Several elements will be randomized each time you play to keep things unpredictable. Should you manage to survive and defeat the boss at the end of the level, you will receive a rating based on your performance. Achieve a high rank and enjoy the added options and unlockables.

Features:

- A new standalone mode to play. Select it from the Main Menu.
- A new map to explore and conquer, designed for multiple playthroughs.
- New mechanics and obstacles to overcome.
- New enemies and a new boss encounter.
- New costumes to unlock.

More information on the new content will be available when it's getting closer, as well as ETA on launch date. In the meantime, feel free to share your thoughts about the update in the comments.

Have a great day!

notes.title: Eldervale 1.0 Released!
notes.content:
Hey all! Eldervale is finally fully released, having added all planned content like extra difficulties, joystick support and translations (more coming soon). It's time to hunt down those unlockable costumes and achievements!

This is not the end of the road for Eldervale though: Now is your time to show your support and tell others if you enjoyed the game!

I will keep listening to feedback and fix any issues as soon as possible. On the other hand, please note that the amount of time I can spend on making new content for the game going forward depends on it's success.

Hope you are having a great day, and see you soon for the next update!

IMPORTANT NOTES: 

- You can select the controller glyphs you want to use by switching between the in-game images in Controls.

- Use the X button on the Xbox controllers to confirm UI selection.

- If running in-game gets interrupted, check your joystick thumbstick or disconnect it if it's not in use.

notes.title: Eldervale Upcoming 1.0 Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Eldervale is near full release! Read on to learn about the major features coming with the update! 

[h1]Special Hard Mode[/h1]
If you enjoy random events or looking for a reason to re-play the game, the new special mode may be just for you! In this mode, previously safe areas can become threatening in a blink of an eye, keeping you on your toes even on subsequent playthroughs. This mode can be enabled together with combat and puzzle hard modes for the ultimate "New Game+" experience.  It's recommended for players who already completed the game once.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991365/74a5e5534de7e172f44d7234b07462e428f96ce5.png[/img]

[h1]Puzzle Hard Mode[/h1]
Like the puzzles the game has to offer? Be prepared to be puzzled all over again, as puzzle hard difficulty reinvents all puzzles to be solved in a different way and removes all helpful clues you would have gotten in a normal playthrough. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991365/813e32280e54354962248cef79fa25a93e8cb2b3.png[/img]

[h1]Joystick Support[/h1]
The support is built for the Xbox One controller but it is expected to be used with the configuration of your choice through Big Picture mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991365/d44bd77d78418783a633ec519e8cf690be911b53.png[/img]

[h1]Translation : Simplified Chinese[/h1]
Thanks to two awesome members of the community and our hard work together, the game is getting a full Simplified Chinese translation! If you'd like to help out and make Eldervale available in your language, please feel free to contact me!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34991365/00b7df09ee760dc074df22bd4ae1fe7264b19265.png[/img]

[h1]Beta Version[/h1]
The beta version currently live, available to all owners of the game to try these new features right now!

You can access the beta by right-clicking Eldervale in your Steam Library, selecting properties and the Betas tab.

[h1]Discord Community[/h1]
Join the Eldervale Discord to learn about future plans and updates firsthand, share your experiences and ask me or the community anything! 

[h1]Thank You[/h1]
...for all the support, fair reviews and feedback! If you enjoy the game, please let others hear your thoughts about it and share it with people who might be interested so I can keep improving and bring you even better content. Cheers!

Added a low health effect on screen to further indicate critical health status.

tags.balance_change: Flashlight light intensity increased slightly.
Killed enemies disappear after a longer period of time.
Deviants now deal slightly less damage on Normal difficulty.
A certain dangerous enemy type now has slightly less health on Normal difficulty.
Enemy damage now capped at 25 (which is common on Hard difficulty).
Hives and exploders no longer respawn.

tags.bug: Unlocked door markers on the map now save correctly.
Selected costumes now save correctly.
Destroyed boards now save correctly.
More events included in the save file.
Fixed a bug which sometimes caused the ending to be played immediately instead of letting you make a choice.
Fixed a bug when starting a new game after resetting the playthrough.
Fixed several achievements which were bugged or inconsistent.

notes.title: Eldervale Patch Notes (0.9.1)
notes.content:
[b]Eldervale Patch Notes (0.9.1)[/b]

Information : You can rebind keys in the launcher by clicking Input. It's a crude system, but may help until I get a more elaborate version working in-game. 

[list]
[*] In-game settings now save properly.

[*] Added option to change difficulty mid playthrough in the Main Menu. 
[*] Added a display of current difficulty settings on the Pause Menu.
[*] Added text to explain how to switch currently shown Map.

[*] Puzzle Easy difficulty clues reworked to be more helpful.
[*] Piano Puzzle clue fixed to be correct when reading it as sheet music.
[*] Symbols Puzzle has additional clues when examining the symbols.

[*] Vending Machines now display item tool tips and stack information.
[*] Vending Machines now display the correct cost of Shotgun Ammunition.
[*] Vending Machines now give a full clip of Handgun Ammo (8) instead of 5.
[*] Removed maximum cap of healing items in Inventory (was 4).
[*] Improved animation when aiming with the Handgun.

[*] Added a light near the 2nd firearm to make it hard to miss.
[*] Added several lights to the game to make those areas less frustrating to navigate.
[*] Stealth sections should feel more consistent when hiding from enemies behind objects.

[*] Character limit increased from 8 to 16 when naming characters.  
[/list]

notes.title: Eldervale Hotfix Patch Notes (0.9.0.3)
notes.content:
[b]Eldervale Hotfix Patch Notes (0.9.0.3)[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the [spoiler]Boss[/spoiler](final enemy) regenerating HP when playing on Easy or Hard Combat Difficulty ! I apologize to everyone who had trouble with it ! 

To make it up to you, I want to include the first 10-15 players who complete the game as an easter egg. If you'd like to participate, post a screenshot of you having unlocked one of the ending achievements in the comments below with the name you want to appear as, or send it to me via e-mail : solkitte@eldervale.com 
[/list]

notes.title: Eldervale Hotfix Patch Notes (0.9.0.1)
notes.content:
[b]Eldervale Hotfix Patch Notes (0.9.0.1)[/b]

[list]
[*]Added tutorials for map use, healing and equipment. They appear when you first pick them up in CH1. This is just a hotfix, I will add an option to turn off tutorials, as well as a UI to display them again any time after you discovered them. 

[*]Adjusted hitboxes for the Alchemy Puzzle and added text reminding you which chemical is which colour.

[*]Additional help for the Piano Puzzle.

[*]Added lights on the Handgun when picking it up so it's harder to miss.

[*]Added lights near the 4th Statue of the Statue Puzzle to make it easily noticeable.

[*]Fixed an issue where certain joysticks could cause an interruption in sprinting.

[*]Fixed an issue with the first enemy's hitbox when going back with a weapon already acquired, as well as damage hitbox of a 2F Nurse when shot from behind.

[*]Numerous other small fixes and adjustments.
[/list]

Hope you have a great day ! Can't wait to bring you more updates and fixes !
